description: This file provides utility functions to parse a MySQL command-line string into a SQLAlchemy DSN string, extracting connection parameters like user, password, and database, and allowing overrides for host and port via environment variables.

methods.name: str parse_mysql_cli_to_dsn(cli_line: str)
methods.description: Converts a MySQL CLI connection string into a SQLAlchemy DSN, applying environment variable overrides for host and port.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str,str] _extract_parts(cli_line: str)
methods.description: Internally extracts user, password, and database information from a MySQL CLI line.
